paired_comparisons.interpretation: All comparisons are exploratory marginal intervals from one training seed. Report regressions and every rule/count cell; this is not final qualification.

decision: Retain all planned runs and primary update19 comparisons. No arm clears the two-player economic floor at update9. Heterogeneous improves A260/3p and economic/4p over control, while homogeneous is stronger at economic/6p. No universally best training recipe established.
limitations: Intermediate checkpoint, one training seed, marginal intervals across many contrasts; not simultaneous significance.
Every old gate remains unchanged. Final qualification and AMD8840U best-model delivery remain incomplete.
